about_the_game:
Oriontis: The Lost Kingdom is a city-building and management game set on the remnants of ancient spaceborne structures. As the captain of a forgotten expedition, you must organize your crew, establish a new colony, and restore order in a hostile world abandoned by the empire.

  • Design and expand your city on floating ancestral platforms

  • Manage resources, supply routes, and the labor force

  • Face fires, civil unrest, disease, and waves of migration

  • Balance military strength, faith, economy, and morale

  • Discover lost technologies and relics from a forgotten era

  • Develop diplomatic or trade relations with other factions

Your mission is not just to build — it is to survive. And perhaps, reclaim a kingdom the empire thought was lost forever.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, 2 GB or AMD Radeon HD 7870, 2 GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 7 1800x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, 3 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580, 4 GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
